criteria.requirement: Add frontmatter.atomic.atomic_update(path, transform, encoding="utf-8", expected_sha256=None) and UpdateConflict for an existing regular file. Strictly validate frontmatter using parse_result, read with the binary-stream loading ability, call transform once with a fresh Post and require a returned Post. Render and encode before touching the target. Use a same-directory temporary, preserve mode/owner, flush+fsync, then os.replace. Clean temporary files and preserve original bytes for every failure before replace. Reject symlink targets, expected-version mismatch and changes observed during the transform before commit; do not claim a lock-free check is a linearizable compare-and-swap against uncooperative external writers. Preserve the already delivered compact/nested JSON, TOML format, reserved metadata, Unicode and body. Missing/malformed documents and transform/encoding/IO failures remain explicit. This is a complete safe-edit API, not just a utility-test step.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
